provenance.procedure: GET /search?query=test&type=series&limit=25 with a Bearer token; synthesised from the published v4 /search contract (ADR-0026). Regenerate with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tvdb search against a real key.
provenance.note: Synthesised: TheTVDB v4 /search returns hits under a flat data array. type=series scopes the search to what the follow flow can act on. The client reads only tvdb_id (a STRING), name, year (a STRING, sometimes absent) and overview, tolerating the many other fields. The third hit deliberately carries no tvdb_id, to prove the client skips a hit it could not turn into a follow rather than surfacing an unfollowable row.
